newsitem.title: USA: Cox, TCI swap cable TV systems.
newsitem.headline: Cox, TCI swap cable TV systems.

text.p: Cox Communications Inc and TCI Communications Inc said Thursday they have completed a deal trading cable television systems that serve about 600,000 customers.

Under the deal, each company will receive about 300,000 new customers in areas that are "contiguous or advantageous to" locations where the companies already have a "significant presence," the companies said in a statement.
TCI will receive Cox's systems in the greater Pittsburgh area; Spokane, Wash.; Springfield, Ill.; Cedar Rapids, Iowa; and the Quad Cities area of Illinois and Iowa; and Saginaw, Mich.
Cox will receive TCI's systems in Bellevue/LaVista, Neb.; Council Bluffs, Iowa; Chesapeake, Va.; Scottsdale, Ariz.; North Attleboro/Taunton, Mass.; Lincoln, R.I.; and St. Bernard, La.
Financial terms of the deal, which was announced in late 1995, were not disclosed.
